criteria.criterion: Use the official Daft Punk MusicBrainz artist record and correct section scope (including all constraints)
criteria.final_justification: The agent did use the correct artist record context (MBID in prompt; Screenshot 1 confirms the correct Album section exists) and stayed within the Album-type release-group scope when opening Homework (Screenshots 2-4 show Type: Album). However, the agent did not proceed to open the first three dated Album entries; only Homework was opened. The claimed inability to see First release date is not an uncontrollable platform blocker (site is accessible and scroll appears possible), so full credit for overall task-scope execution is not warranted.

criteria.criterion: Album entry #1: first dated entry in displayed chronological order
criteria.final_justification: Title is correctly identified/opened (Homework), but the required complete release-group "First release date" was not reported. The screenshots do not confirm a platform-level blocker (no CAPTCHA/login/down); they only show that the agent did not locate the field/value in the visible area. This is a critical missing required datum, so only minimal partial credit for opening the correct release-group page and not fabricating the date.

criteria.criterion: Album entry #2: second dated entry in displayed chronological order
criteria.final_justification: The agent neither opened the Discovery release-group page nor reported its release-group First release date. No uncontrollable blocker is evidenced that would prevent attempting Discovery after Homework (site appears accessible). Therefore this criterion is not satisfied.

criteria.criterion: Album entry #3: third dated entry in displayed chronological order (and stop after three)
criteria.final_justification: The agent did not open the third qualifying Album entry’s release-group page and did not report its First release date. As with criterion 2, there is no confirmed uncontrollable blocker preventing the attempt. Criterion not met.
